Players Committee card image of [[Blue 11]] (original printing), game text: “May add 1 pilot and 2 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Once per turn, may deploy a non-pilot Rebel of ability < 5 aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.”

The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
